notice: DECISION SUPPORT METADATA - NOT BLOCKCHAIN EVIDENCE

baseline_descriptions.CONTINUE_SAME_CHAIN: Continue forward chronological tracing on the current blockchain network.
baseline_descriptions.FOLLOW_CROSS_CHAIN_LINK: Continue tracing through a verified protocol-specific cross-chain link to its destination network.

CONTINUE_SAME_CHAIN.Variant_A: Continue automated chronological tracing on the current blockchain while unresolved outgoing branches remain available for investigation.
CONTINUE_SAME_CHAIN.Variant_B: Trace the next valid same-chain transfers when unresolved branches remain and provider coverage allows continued traversal.
CONTINUE_SAME_CHAIN.Variant_C: Continue the active fund-flow investigation on the current network by following unresolved chronological transfer branches.

FOLLOW_CROSS_CHAIN_LINK.Variant_A: Continue fund-flow tracing on the destination blockchain through an already verified cross-chain transfer when destination tracing remains pending.
FOLLOW_CROSS_CHAIN_LINK.Variant_B: Follow the verified cross-chain relay to the destination network and continue the investigation there.
FOLLOW_CROSS_CHAIN_LINK.Variant_C: Continue the investigation on the destination chain after the cross-chain link has been verified but destination tracing is not yet complete.
